headline: This year, IDB Invest will have record investment of 1,400 million dollars in Mexico
summary: The private arm of the Inter-American Development Bank group plans a record $1.4 billion investment in Mexico this year. It expects 2027 to bring more execution of infrastructure and energy projects.
why: IDB Invest is the private-sector investment arm of the Inter-American Development Bank, financing infrastructure, energy and private companies across Latin America.
original_headline: Este año, BID Invest tendrá inversión récord de 1,400 millones de dólares en México
